Angular stylised 3D animation, brush-stroke texture, Surrey, 1894, morning sun from the left, black shadow.
[Shot 1] From 00:00 to 00:07. The shot opens on an insert across the top of the black wrought-iron gate: <Subject 2>'s inky fingers passing a newspaper folded tight in quarters, its plain grey folded edge toward the camera, over the gate into <Subject 1>'s hand in its grey tweed cuff; only that object and what touches it is in frame. The camera is beside the gate at the height of the gate top, an arm's length from the paper, a 90mm lens. The morning sun comes from the LEFT onto the paper. At the first frame the black iron gate top crosses the BOTTOM third of the frame from the LEFT edge to the RIGHT edge. The tight-folded newspaper passes over it edge-on at the CENTRE, the boy's hand at the LEFT third and the Narrator's grey tweed cuff at the RIGHT third. The dark laurels fill the TOP half behind. The shot is inside this place: The front of the narrator's red-brick villa at Maybury at a quarter to nine on a clear summer morning in 1894: a black front door under a small red-tiled porch, a canted bay window with white sashes, a knee-high red-brick wall with a black wrought-iron gate, clipped laurels and a privet hedge, a gravel road climbing to the right. The camera tracks sideways to the left along the top of the iron gate, past the passing newspaper as a grey tweed cuff reaches in and takes the folded paper, from 00:00 to 00:04. At 00:04 inky fingers point away down the road, and the movement continues to the last frame of the shot. By 00:07 the camera is tracking through the last frame, and the action continues with it.
